audit_items.proof_trace: Go map iteration order is non-deterministic. When building cellsIndices from sidecarByIndex map (L79-82), indices may be appended in random order across different executions. The c-kzg-4844 library's RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs expects sorted, distinct indices (confirmed by spec test L45-58). Non-deterministic reconstruction can yield different results or failures across nodes, breaking consensus.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends same data column sidecar set to multiple peers. Due to map iteration randomness, different nodes build cellsIndices in different orders. Some nodes may pass unsorted indices to c-kzg library causing reconstruction failure or incorrect recovery, while others succeed. This creates a consensus split where nodes disagree on block validity.
